resources.string: Stop the assistant before restoring or undoing data.
A local rollback snapshot is saved before restore. New backups include pending energy, original expiry, lifetime statistics and selected settings. Missing fields in older backups keep local values.
Last backup failed. Check storage or export again.
Only the selected public backup file is deleted. This cannot be undone. Local listening data is unchanged.
Readable backups (access depends on the system)
The assistant was interrupted or the device restarted. You can restart the bubble. The curtain and timer are not resumed automatically; set the timer again.
Previous timer reference: %1$d minutes remaining. Its end action was not executed during interruption.
The previous timer was for this episode. Select the player again.
Valid pending energy in backup: %1$d. Original expiry is preserved.
The previous restore is incomplete and storage cannot be written. The original rollback snapshot is retained. Check free space and reopen the app. The assistant and new data writes are paused.
